rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good-quality blastocyst, but it overstates image-specific detail and includes likely fabricated observations such as exact ICM clock-face position, dark granular cytoplasm, tight cell-cell junctions, and herniation potential. It also inconsistently describes a 2AA as near/full blastocyst despite the provided grading.

Integrates maternal age, PCOS, BMI, endometrium, sperm quality, first-cycle status, and transfer timing with embryo quality and prognosis. Some factors are inferred beyond the provided data, but overall the case integration is strong.

The reasoning is structured and mostly logical, especially around age-related aneuploidy moderating morphology-based optimism. Minor issues include inconsistent handling of the expansion grade and somewhat speculative numeric calculations.

Mostly aligned on single embryo transfer and caution about age-related aneuploidy, but several recommendations are not strongly guideline-based or are overly prescriptive, including routine low-dose aspirin, estradiol threshold targets, embryo banking/freeze-all suggestions, and DHEA use in this PCOS case.

Provides clear next steps for transfer, follow-up, and future planning, including eSET, luteal support, beta-hCG timing, and consideration of PGT-A. Some recommendations are more specific than evidence supports, but overall it is practical and useful.
